## `current_project`

*Available in [Python](#current_project-python)*
=== "Python"
    <h4>Description</h4>
    Returns the currently active CIDA project or None

    Searches recursively for a CIDA project config file, starting at the working directory and working upwards
    toward the root directory.
    <h4>Usage</h4>
    ```python
    current_project(
        project_root=None
    )
    ```
    <h4>Arguments</h4>

    - `project_root` (`Path | str | None`) - The root directory for the project.

    <h4>Returns `CIDAProject | None`</h4>

    A CIDAProject object or None
